_comment: Replaces Minecraft's pixel font everywhere: menus, chat, signs, books,
item names, and this mod's own screens.
Order matters. Providers listed later win, so the vanilla includes stay
first as a fallback and the TrueType entry sits last to take priority.
Keeping include/default is what stops Chinese, Japanese and Korean text
from turning into boxes - Inter has no glyphs for them, and without a
fallback those characters would simply vanish from chat.
If the text sits too high or too low, change shift. If it looks too big
